scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hmmm...
You must have come,
sensing that someone
is waiting for you here.
Tell me, do you seek
the path of patience?
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯...
你一定是感觉到
有人在这里等你才来的吧。
告诉我，你在寻找
忍耐之道吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
I see.
To each his own,
I suppose. Take
care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
我明白了。
各人有各人的路，
我想是这样吧。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Very well.
Then, let me
set you on that
path right away...
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
很好。
那么，让我立刻
指引你踏上
那条道路...

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hm? I cannot be
of any service to
you until you grow
a little stronger...
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯？在你变得
稍微强大一些之前，
我恐怕无法
为你效劳...

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hmm...
You and I...
We are fairly equal in
terms of combat ability.
Perhaps we can spar
together sometime.
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯...
你和我...
在战斗能力上
旗鼓相当。
也许我们可以
找个时间切磋一下。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
I... I've never
seen a baby as
powerful as you!
G-get away, you
freak of nature!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
我...我从未见过
像你这么强的婴儿！
快...快滚开，你这个
怪物！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hm? Have you come to
learn how to be a Ninja?
You're not quite experienced
enough yet, so come back
after you're more familiar
with fighting monsters.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
嗯？你是来学习
如何成为忍者的吗？
你的经验还不够丰富，
等你更熟悉
如何战斗魔物后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
H-hello?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。
你...你好？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
...............................
How did you do that?

[{0}]
Do what? I didn't
do anything, I don't think...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
做什么？我什么
都没做，我想...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
H-How are you able to
see me? I'm supposed to
be invisible to the naked eye.
Ah, now I get it. Wildcat Joe
must have sent you to kill me! I won't fall for your tricks! Die!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你...你怎么能
看见我？我应该是
肉眼看不见的。
啊，我明白了。一定是
野猫乔派你来杀我的！
我不会上你的当的！
去死吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait! I-I don't even
know who Wildcat Joe is!
Calm down, there's no
need to get violent!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等...等等！我甚至
不知道野猫乔是谁！
冷静点，没必要
动武！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?
How did you dodge
all of my attacks?
You've got some talent,
I'll give you that.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什...什么？
你怎么躲开了
我所有的攻击？
你确实有些天赋，
我承认。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...............................
I came here hoping
to change my job
to a Ninja.

[Kuuga Gai]
...Oh. Is that all?
Hmm, you've got great
potential, but I can't help
you now. I've got too many
enemies, and I can't let my
guard down for even a second.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
...哦。就这？
嗯，你很有潜力，
但我现在帮不了你。
我的敌人太多了，
我不能有丝毫松懈。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
That Wildcat Joe is
completely ruthless...!
He could strike at any time!
He'll do anything to achieve
victory over his enemies!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
那个野猫乔
真是冷酷无情...！
他随时可能出手！
为了战胜敌人，
他会不择手段！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Wait, wait, I just
thought of something.
Maybe you can help me out.
Do what I ask, and I'll teach
you a few of my skills if you
really want to be a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
等等，等等，我
刚想到一件事。
也许你能帮帮我。
照我说的做，如果你
真的想成为忍者，
我就教你几招。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hm? Well, alright.
Still, I don't see
why we can't help
each other in this
little predicament...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
嗯？好吧。
不过，我看不出
为什么我们不能
在这困境中
互相帮助...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Great! Now, I wanted to
ask Wildcat Joe if he'd
agree to a temporary truce.
I'm aware that both of us
are out of weapons, so we
should get well equipped first.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
太好了！现在，我想
问问野猫乔是否愿意
暂时停战。
我知道我们俩
都缺武器，所以
我们应该先装备好。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Please take this letter,
and deliver it to Wildcat
Joe in Einbroch. He's a master
of disguise, so keep a careful
eye out for him. Ah, and look
for him in a high place.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
请把这封信
带给艾音布罗克的
野猫乔。他擅长伪装，
所以请仔细寻找他。
啊，还有，
在高处找他。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Yeah, Wildcat Joe
always did have a thing
for hiding in high places.
Anyway, after you give him
the letter, come back and
let me know his answer.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
是啊，野猫乔
总是喜欢藏在高处。
总之，你把信交给他之后，
回来告诉我他的回答。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Even if this task
isn't that urgent,
please hurry over to
Einbroch and deliver
my letter to Wildcat Joe.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
虽然这件事
不算特别紧急，
但还是请你尽快去艾音布罗克，
把我的信交给野猫乔。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Did you deliver that
letter to Wildcat Joe?
I still need to know his
response to my proposal
for a truce. Anyway, see
if you can needle him for it.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你把那封信
交给野猫乔了吗？
我还需要知道
他对我停战提议的回应。
总之，
试着去逼问他一下。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Ah, you've returned.
So did Wildcat Joe send
you back here with his
response? Great, great,
please let me read it.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
啊，你回来了。
那么，野猫乔
让你带回了他的回应？
太好了，太好了，
请让我读一下。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?! How could he
reject my proposal for
a truce?! This can only
mean that he's made another
Kunai. Nuts! I have to catch
up to him, or I'm a goner!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什...什么？！他怎么能
拒绝我的停战提议？！
这只能说明
他又做了一把苦无。
该死！我得赶上去，
不然我就完蛋了！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Listen, you've got to help
me out again! I need you to
gather some materials so that
I can craft my own Kunai to fight Wildcat Joe. Then, I'll go ahead
and change your job to a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
听着，你得再帮个忙！
我需要你去收集一些材料，
这样我才能打造一把自己的苦无，
去和野猫乔战斗。然后，
我会把你的职业
转职为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
All you need
to bring me is
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
Please get those
as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你只需要给我带
^3355FF5赛依伐^000000和
^3355FF1强化武器金属-级数一^000000。
请尽可能快地去收集！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? That's funny,
Wildcat Joe actually
asked me to gather
those same materials.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？真巧，
野猫乔也正好让我
去收集那些材料。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Curses! Then that means...
You actually helped Joe
in crafting his Kunai! No!
I should have thought about
that earlier! Well, it's too
late now. Just h-hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
该死！那就意味着...
你实际上是在帮乔
打造他的苦无！不！
我早该想到这一点的！
唉，现在说这些也没用了。
快...快点行动吧！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hurry and bring
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000 to me,
so that I can craft
my own Kunai to use
against Wildcat Joe!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
快点把
^3355FF5赛依伐^000000和
^3355FF1强化武器金属-级数一^000000带给我，
这样我才能打造一把自己的苦无，
用来对抗野猫乔！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Whoa, whoa...
You still have some
leftover Skill Points.
You'd better spend all
of them before you
change jobs, right?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
哇哦，哇哦...
你还有剩余的技能点。
在转职之前，
你最好把它们都用掉，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Ah, you're back with
everything that I need.
You've come earlier than
I expected, eh? Great,
as promised, I'll turn
you into a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
啊，你带着我需要的
所有东西回来了。
你来得比我预想的要早啊？
太好了，
如我所承诺的那样，
我会把你转职为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Let me formally introduce
myself. I am High Ninja Kuuga Gai
in the Touga Ninja Corps, and
I'm in charge of the search
party to find Sir Kazma.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
让我正式介绍一下自己。
我是土加忍者军团的
上忍空牙·盖，
负责寻找卡兹马大人的搜查队。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Sir Kazma is the chief
of my village, but he's
run away. This has resulted
in an internal conflict within
the Ninja Corps. Things are
pretty unstable right now...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
卡兹马大人是我村庄的首领，
但他逃跑了。这导致了
忍者军团内部的冲突。
现在的局势相当不稳定...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
I initially didn't want to
accept you as a Ninja because
of this complicated situation.
However, you've proven that
you're truly worthy of joining
the Ninja ranks.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
起初，由于局势复杂，
我并不想接受你成为忍者。
然而，你已经证明了
你确实有资格
加入忍者行列。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
According to his letter, even
Joe thinks highly of you. Just
remember that, as a Ninja, your
mission is your highest priority. But don't let mission objectives
supersede your conscience.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
根据他的信，
连乔也很看重你。
请记住，作为忍者，
你的任务是你最高的优先事项。
但不要为了任务目标
而违背你的良心。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
''Secrecy above all else.''
To keep our secrets in the
shadows, you can only buy
or sell Ninja weapons with
authorized dealers. Please
keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
“保密高于一切。”
为了在阴影中保守秘密，
你只能向授权的荷官
购买或出售忍者武器。
请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
As of today, you are
now a proud member of the
Touga Ninja Corps. Be as
agile as the wind, and as
quiet as the falling shadows.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
从今天起，
你成为了土加忍者军团
光荣的一员。
要像风一样敏捷，
像落下的阴影一样安静。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
How have you been?
Train hard: you want
to be able to vanish
without a trace. If you
can do that, you'll get
the respect of any Ninja~
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
最近怎么样？
好好训练：
你要做到消失得无影无踪。
如果你能做到，
你会赢得任何忍者的尊重~

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
How have you been?
Train hard: you want
to be able to vanish
without a trace. If you
can do that, you'll get
the respect of any Ninja~
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
最近怎么样？
好好训练：
你要做到消失得无影无踪。
如果你能做到，
你会赢得任何忍者的尊重~

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?
How were you able
to find me hidden
in the shadows?!
You must be more than
a common adventurer, eh?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什...什么？
你是怎么找到
藏在阴影中的我的？！
你一定不只是个普通的冒险者，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
I've traveled to many
countries, but I've never
been on a building as high
as Einbroch Tower. All the
buildings in my hometown
are tiny in comparison...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
我游历过许多国家，
但从未见过像艾音布罗克中央塔
这样高的建筑。
相比之下，我家乡的建筑
都显得十分渺小...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, are you from
Amatsu? I'm looking
for someone named
Wildcat Joe from there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你是从樱花城来的吗？
我正在找那里一个叫
野猫乔的人。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
...No. No, I'm actually
from Izlude, and I'm only
here in Einbroch for some
minerals. Tell me, why are
you looking for this Wildcat Joe?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...不，不，我其实是
从依斯鲁得岛来的，
只是来艾音布罗克
寻找一些矿石。
告诉我，你为什么要找
这个野猫乔？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I need to deliver
this letter to him and
get his response so that
I can become a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我需要把这封信
交给他，并得到他的回复，
这样我才能成为一名忍者。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Really? Now that I think
about it, I do think that I've
run once or twice into him
in this town. Though, he prefers to be called ''Red Leopard Joe,''
instead of ''Wildcat Joe.''
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
真的吗？仔细想想，
我觉得我在这个城镇
见过他一两次。
不过，他更喜欢被称为
“红豹 乔”，
而不是“野猫乔”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I really want to help you
find him, but first I need
to find the minerals that
I'm looking for. If you don't
mind, would you help me?
Then I can help you find Joe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我真的很想帮你找到他，
但我得先找到我正在寻找的矿石。
如果你不介意的话，
能帮帮我吗？
这样我就能帮你找乔了。

scripts.text: Don't worry, I'll find him alone.
scripts.translation: 别担心，我会自己找到他的。

scripts.text: Sure, I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 当然，我会帮你。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
You sure about that...?
Red Leopard Joe is a true
master of disguise. You'll
need all the help you can
get to find him...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
你确定吗...？
红豹 乔是伪装的大师。
你需要尽可能多的帮助
才能找到他...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Great, I'm glad to
hear that. Please
help me find
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
太好了，很高兴听到
这个消息。请帮我寻找
^3355FF5赛依伐^000000和
^3355FF1强化武器金属-级数一^000000。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Please bring
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000 to me as
soon as you can. Then,
I can help you find
Red Leopard Joe.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
请尽快把
^3355FF5赛依伐^000000和
^3355FF1强化武器金属-级数一^000000
带给我。然后，
我就可以帮你找
红豹 乔了。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Good, good. You've
brought the minerals...
Now, it's my turn to
help you now. Here,
let me see that letter.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
很好，很好。你带来了
矿石...
现在，轮到我来
帮你了。来，
让我看看那封信。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Why? Didn't you bring Kuuga Gai's letter for me?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
为什么？你不是带了
空牙·盖的信给我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you...
Are you Wildcat Joe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你是
野猫乔？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
...Yes, but I prefer to
be called Red Leopard Joe.
Kuuga Gai sent you to me, right?
He's the only one who calls
me that. So you want to be
a Ninja, eh? Hmm, alright.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...是的，但我更喜欢
被称为红豹 乔。
是空牙·盖派你来的，对吧？
只有他那样叫我。所以你想
成为一名忍者，是吗？嗯，好吧。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
If you want to be a Ninja,
you should always be careful
of what you see and what you trust. Don't forget that if your
secrets are ever discovered, then you're finished as a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
如果你想成为忍者，
你应该时刻注意
你看到什么以及你信任什么。
别忘了，如果你的秘密
被发现，那你作为忍者
就结束了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Remember to move
quickly, and to always
vanish without a trace.
To remain hidden in the
shadows is really our
ultimate power.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
记住要行动迅速，
并且总是消失得无影无踪。
隐藏在阴影中
才是我们真正的终极力量。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
For now, let me read
this letter. Let's see...
Hm. I thought that Kuuga Gai
would want to challenge me
again, but he actually wants
a temporary truce? Hah!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
暂时，让我读一下
这封信。让我看看...
嗯。我以为空牙·盖
想再次向我挑战，
但他实际上想要
暂时的休战？哈！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Thanks to your help,
I now have the minerals
I need to construct a Kunai!
Hahaha! I won't agree to a truce when I have the advantage!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
多亏你的帮助，
我现在已经获得了
制造苦无所需的矿石！
哈哈哈！既然我占了上风，
我怎么可能同意休战！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Anyway, let me write my
response to him. I'll also
give you my recommendation...
I think you'll make a very fine
Ninja, even if I did trick you
just earlier. Heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
总之，让我写封回信给他。
顺便也给你一些建议...
虽然刚才我骗了你，
但我认为你会成为一名
非常出色的忍者。嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Here you go.
Please bring this
letter to Kuuga Gai.
It'll take a while to
return to Amatsu, so let
me send you there directly...
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
给你。
请把这封信
带给空牙·盖。
回到樱花城需要一段时间，
所以我直接送你过去吧...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Eh? I'm not sure what
happened, but it seems
that you haven't delivered
my response to Kuuga Gai yet.
Shall I directly send you
to Amatsu right now?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
咦？我不确定发生了什么，
但看来你还没有
把我的回信交给空牙·盖。
要我现在直接送你
去樱花城吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Alright. Well, I was
just trying to save
you some time.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好吧。我只是想
帮你节省一些时间而已。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Okay, then.
Goodbye for now.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好的，那就这样吧。
暂时再见。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Kuuga Gai asked you to
gather some materials
too? Oh well, I suppose
that I can't blame him.
Besides, I should be able
to beat him in a fair fight~
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
空牙·盖还让你
去收集一些材料？
算了，我也不能怪他。
而且，在公平的战斗中，
我一定能打败他~

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Oh, you're a Ninja~
I hope you continue to
train yourself and master
all the Ninja skills that
you can. Always remember
to blend into the shadows.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
哦，你是忍者~
希望你能继续修炼，
掌握所有你能掌握的
忍者技能。永远记住
要融入阴影之中。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've traveled to many
countries, but I've never
been on a building as high
as Einbroch Tower. All the
buildings in my hometown
are tiny in comparison...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我游历过许多国家，
但从未见过像艾音布罗克
中央塔这么高的建筑。
相比之下，我家乡的建筑
都显得很小...
